name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's journey into motorsport PR began with a childhood fascination for Formula One, fueled by late-night broadcasts and the roar of engines echoing through his family's apartment. He pursued a degree in Communications, focusing on crisis management and brand reputation, before landing an internship with a smaller racing team. There, he honed his skills, navigating media relations and crafting compelling narratives around the drivers and their races.

His approach to PR is rooted in authenticity and innovation. Kenji believes in building genuine relationships with journalists and fans alike, leveraging social media and new technologies to create engaging content. He is driven by a desire to elevate the profile of Aston Martin and its drivers, ensuring their stories resonate with a global audience. He is known for his out-of-the-box ideas and ability to generate positive buzz, even in the face of adversity, making him a valuable asset to the team.

Kenji's distinctive ability lies in his understanding of both the technical and emotional aspects of motorsport. He speaks fluent English, Japanese, and passable Italian, helping him connect with a diverse range of individuals within the sport. His passion for racing, coupled with his strategic communication skills, makes him an effective and respected PR professional.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part and subtle gel.
physical.description: Kenji is of average height, with a lean build and a focused, intelligent gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with story ideas and potential headlines.
Has a habit of pacing while on important phone calls.
Prefers communicating via concise bullet points in emails.
